
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(RNAAgeCalc)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
prostate_trans_age = read.csv("raw_data/bio_age_prostate_updated.csv")

thyroid_samples = read.csv("raw_data/final_samples_112.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(tissue_type = tissue_type2)
thyroid_rna_counts = read.delim("raw_data/all_samples_genes_counts_2026.matrix")

colnames(thyroid_rna_counts) = sub(".*(SC[0-9]+).*", "\\1", colnames(thyroid_rna_counts))
rownames(thyroid_rna_counts) = thyroid_rna_counts[[1]]
thyroid_rna_counts = thyroid_rna_counts[ , -1]
thyroid_rna_counts[["SC873736_37"]] = rowMeans(thyroid_rna_counts[, c("SC873736", "SC873737")], na.rm = TRUE)
thyroid_rna_counts[["SC873739_40"]] = rowMeans(thyroid_rna_counts[, c("SC873739", "SC873740")], na.rm = TRUE)
thyroid_sample_ids = thyroid_samples$sample_id
thyroid_rna_counts_109 = thyroid_rna_counts[ , colnames(thyroid_rna_counts) %in% thyroid_sample_ids]
```

```{r}
thyroid_chron_age = thyroid_samples %>% 
  dplyr::select(sample_id, chron_age)

thyroid_trans_age = predict_age(exprdata = thyroid_rna_counts_109, tissue = "thyroid",
                                exprtype = "counts", idtype = "ENSEMBL", stype = "all",
                                chronage = as.data.frame(thyroid_chron_age))
```

```{r}
prostate_clinical = read.csv("data/final_prostate_clinical.csv")
prostate_trans_age <- prostate_trans_age %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    prostate_clinical %>%
      dplyr::select(-X, -WTC., -group),
    by = "subject_id"
  )

thyroid_trans_age$sample_id = rownames(thyroid_trans_age)
rownames(thyroid_trans_age) = NULL

all_clinical_thyroid = read_excel("data/all_samples_clinical.xlsx")

thyroid_trans_age = thyroid_trans_age |> 
  left_join(all_clinical_thyroid |> dplyr::select(sample_id, tissue_type2),
            by = "sample_id")

thyroid_trans_age = thyroid_trans_age |> 
  filter(!tissue_type2 == "Thyroiditis")

thyroid_clinical = read.csv("data/nthyroid_clinical_full.csv")
thyroid_trans_age = thyroid_trans_age |>
  left_join(
    thyroid_clinical |>
  dplyr::select(sample_id, group, sex, race_binary, tissue_type_group, ms_histology),
  by = "sample_id")

thyroid_tumor_trans_age = thyroid_trans_age |> 
  filter(tissue_type_group == "Cancer")

thyroid_tumor_trans_age <- thyroid_tumor_trans_age %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ms_histology_simple = dplyr::case_when(
      
      
      stringr::str_detect(
        ms_histology,
        stringr::regex("papillary", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Papillary thyroid carcinoma",
      
      
      stringr::str_detect(
        ms_histology,
        stringr::regex(
          "follicular carcinoma|follicular adenocarcinoma|oxyphilic adenocarcinoma",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) ~ "Follicular thyroid carcinoma",
      
      is.na(ms_histology) ~ NA_character_,
      
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

thyroid_normal_trans_age = thyroid_trans_age |> 
  filter(tissue_type_group == "Normal")

prostate_trans_age$sex = "M"
prostate_trans_age$tissue = "Prostate"
prostate_trans_age = prostate_trans_age |> 
  rename(AgeAccelResid = age_acceleration, sample_id= subject_id)
prostate_trans_age <- prostate_trans_age %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      group %in% c("WTC Exposed", "WTC-exposed", "WTC Responder") ~
        "WTC Responder",
      
      group %in% c("WTC Unexposed", "WTC-unexposed", "Control") ~
        "Control",
      
      TRUE ~ as.character(group)
    ),
    
    race = dplyr::case_when(
      race == "White" ~ "White",
      is.na(race) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ "Non-White"
    )
  )
    

thyroid_tumor_trans_age$tissue = "Thyroid"
thyroid_tumor_trans_age = thyroid_tumor_trans_age |> 
  rename(race = race_binary)
thyroid_tumor_trans_age <- thyroid_tumor_trans_age %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      group %in% c("WTC Exposed", "WTC-exposed", "WTC Responder", "WTC Case") ~
        "WTC Responder",
      
      group %in% c("WTC Unexposed", "WTC-unexposed", "Control") ~
        "Control",
      
      TRUE ~ as.character(group)
    )
  )


pt_tumors = rbind(
  prostate_trans_age |>
    dplyr::select(sample_id, RNAAge, ChronAge, AgeAccelResid, group, sex, race, tissue),
  thyroid_tumor_trans_age |>
    dplyr::select(sample_id, RNAAge, ChronAge, AgeAccelResid, group, sex, race, tissue)
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    tissue = factor(tissue)
  )
```

```{r}
pt_tumors <- pt_tumors %>%
  filter(sample_id != "SC873777")
thyroid_normal_trans_age <- thyroid_normal_trans_age %>%
  filter(sample_id != "SC873846")
```

```{r}
all_tumors_model = lm(AgeAccelResid ~ group + sex + race + tissue, data = pt_tumors)
summary(all_tumors_model)
confint(all_tumors_model)
```

```{r}
prostate_tumors_model = lm(AgeAccelResid ~ group + race + gleason, data = prostate_trans_age)
summary(prostate_tumors_model)
confint(prostate_tumors_model)
```

```{r}
thyroid_tumors_model = lm(AgeAccelResid ~ group + sex + race + ms_histology_simple, data = thyroid_tumor_trans_age)
summary(thyroid_tumors_model)
confint(thyroid_tumors_model)
```

```{r}
thyroid_normals_model = lm(AgeAccelResid ~ group + sex + race_binary, data = thyroid_normal_trans_age)
summary(thyroid_normals_model)
confint(thyroid_normals_model)
```
